          "status": "correct",
          "marksAvailable": 1.0,
          "marksAwarded": 1.0,
          "marksDeducted": 0.0,
          "teacherAnnotation": "✓ Correct substitution of tan θ and cot θ, adjustment of sign, and simplification",
          "mistakeType": null,
          "correctedWorking": null,
          "isDeparture": false,
          "departureKind": null,
          "isReturn": false
        },
        {
          "stepNumber": 2,
          "part": null,
          "description": "Combine the fractions over a common denominator",
          "studentWork": "= (sin³θ − cos³θ)/(sinθ cosθ (sinθ − cosθ))",
          "status": "correct",
          "marksAvailable": 1.0,
          "marksAwarded": 1.0,
          "marksDeducted": 0.0,
          "teacherAnnotation": "✓ Correct algebraic combination into a single fraction",
          "mistakeType": null,
          "correctedWorking": null,
          "isDeparture": false,
          "departureKind": null,
          "isReturn": false
        },
        {
          "stepNumber": 3,
          "part": null,
          "description": "Factorise the numerator using a³ − b³ and simplify to RHS",
          "studentWork": "= (sinθ − cosθ)(sin²θ + sinθ cosθ + cos²θ)/(sinθ cosθ (sinθ − cosθ))\n= (1 + sinθ cosθ)/(sinθ cosθ)\n= 1/(sinθ cosθ) + 1\n= 1 + secθ cosecθ = RHS. Hence proved.",
          "status": "correct",
          "marksAvailable": 1.0,
          "marksAwarded": 1.0,
          "marksDeducted": 0.0,
          "teacherAnnotation": "✓ Correct factorisation, cancellation of common factors, and simplification to RHS",
          "mistakeType": null,
          "correctedWorking": null,
          "isDeparture": false,
          "departureKind": null,
          "isReturn": false
        }
      ],
      "mistakeSummary": {
        "conceptual": 0,
        "calculation": 0,
        "silly": 0,
        "presentation": 0
      },
      "studentFinalAnswer": "1 + secθ cosecθ = RHS. Hence proved.",
      "finalAnswerCorrect": true,
      "teacherNote": "Excellent and rigorous proof. Every intermediate step, including the sign reversal in the denominator and the algebraic factorisation, is shown clearly."
